description: A Roman occupation site dated from the 1st to the 4th CE. There is a great deal of pre and post Roman activity, but the Roman occupation phases have had a 'sacred association' proposed, this may be due to a number of buildings being associated with a number of pits and well deposits.
bibliography: Allen, Martyn, Tom Brindle, Alex Smith, Julian D Richards, Tim Evans, Neil Holbrook, Michael Fulford, and Nathan Blick. “The Rural Settlement of Roman Britain: An Online Resource.” Archaeology Data Service, 2015. https://doi.org/10.5284/1030449.
Orton, Clive Robert. “Excavations at the King William IV Site, Ewell, 1967-77.” Surrey Archaeological Collections 84 (2002): 89122. https://doi.org/10.5284/1069226.
